The pain was in the cheek area and sometimes in the mucosa, more

She does not have any eye symptoms, no visual

The patient presented for elective decompression of the right 
trigeminal nerve for trigeminal neuralgia.

See operative report 
for details, but briefly the procedure was complicated by 
excessive venous bleeding in the setting of chronic 
thrombocytopenia.

Her postoperative CT head showed a 
moderate-sized hematoma in the prepontine, premedullary and 
cerebellopontine cisterns extending along the tentorial 
leaflets, with mass effect on the pons and medulla.

There was 
also minimal hemorrhage within the fourth ventricle.

The patient 
was transfered to the ICU and received platelet and DDAVP.

She 
was noted to have diplopia with a right INO as well as a new 
right facial droop.

She was placed on dexamethasone to prevent 
post surgical edema.

on ___ the patient's repeat head CT was stable but she had some 
bloody secretions as well as coffee ground emesis.

Her incision 
site continued to ooze.

She was started on IV protonix and had 
an NG tube placed to suction.

Her platelets remained stable 
around 100.
She was still successfully extubated.
On ___ overnight the patient had a desaturation to the ___.

A 
chest xray showed pulmonary edema and effusions so she was 
diuresed with 20mg of IV lasix which improved her respiratory 
status.

She was continued on ancef for post 
surgical prophylaxis.

A hematology consult was obtained for the 
unusual bleeding and they felt that if bleeding continues we can 
start her on prednision.

They recommend that we keep her 
platelets greater that 100.
___, she remained stable in the ICU.

On ___, she recieved 
lasix 20mg x 1 in AM with improvement in her respiratory status.

She remained stable neurologically and transfer orders were 
written for her to go to the step down unit.

She complains of no 
hearing deficits.
On ___ the patient continued to be negative about 1 liter with
IV lasix, though she continued to require 4 liters of oxygen.
Her cranial nerve deficits continued to improve.

She was 
reevaluated by speech and swallow who recommended starting a 
modified diet.
On ___, she had continued hypoxia and medicine was consulted.
A
CTA Chest revealed no PE and ekg was normal.

Electrolytes were 
repleted and blood pressure controlled.

A Echo showed no heart 
failure or valvular abormalities.

On ___, oxygen was weaned and patient was oxygenating 97-98% on 
room air.
Pain was controlled with oral medications.

The patient 
did not have any nausea.

The incision was clean, dry and intact 
with non-absorbable sutures.

Two staples were removed from the R 
forehead.
Oral Keflex was restarted for prophylaxis.

The patient continued 
to have the neurologic deficits as described above.

All plans 
and instructions were clearly related to patient and husband at 
bedside.

All questions were answered and the patient expressed 
readiness for discharge.
